source.paper: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
source.authors: Kaplan, McCandlish, Henighan, Brown, Chess, Child, Gray, Radford, Wu, Amodei
source.setup: Decoder-only Transformers trained on WebText2 (BPE, 50,257-token vocabulary); loss is test cross-entropy in nats per token, so values are tokenization- and dataset-specific

laws.label: Compute
laws.testedNote: the paper reports the trend across about eight orders of magnitude of compute (roughly 10⁻⁸ to 1 PF-day in its Figure 13)

laws.label: Parameters
laws.testedNote: models from 768 to 1.5 billion non-embedding parameters, trained to convergence on a large dataset

laws.label: Data
laws.testedNote: datasets from 22 million to 23 billion tokens, for large models trained with early stopping
